change_summary: The journal has published an expression of concern about this paper. The editors say they have concerns about some of the data in the article and are looking into it. The notice does not say which data are affected, and no outcome has been reported yet. The paper has not been retracted or corrected.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as the main support for a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says your proposal builds on it. The journal has issued an expression of concern about some of the paper's data. It does not say which data, so it is uncertain whether the forced-swim result you rely on is affected. Because your argument rests mainly on this paper, the change matters moderately until the investigation reports.
recommendation: Because the journal has issued an expression of concern about some of the data without saying which, and your Discussion leans on this paper as key evidence, hedge that sentence, cite the notice, and don't build new work on the finding until the investigation reports.

alerts.what_changed: The journal's editors issued an expression of concern saying they have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article. The matter is under investigation and no outcome has been given.
alerts.reason: An expression of concern about data puts the findings in doubt. The notice does not say which data are affected, so no specific figure can be named, and no later notice resolves it.
